name: Filter design flavors: ladder, diode, comb, formant
goal: Pick filter *design* (not just LP/HP/BP): ladder/analog-style for classic resonant subtractive tone; diode for EMS/303-ish acid character (retune resonance when switching); formant XY vowel morphs; comb (tiny delayed copy + mix) for peaks/nulls, keyed harmonic shaping, phasing/flanging, and self-oscillation/string-like plucks—then A/B drive+resonance.

source.title: Vital's Filter Types Explained | Sound Design Tutorial

prerequisites: Hybrid synth or Web Audio filters exposing multiple models (ladder/diode/comb/formant) or approximations

outputs.name: filter_flavor_notes
outputs.description: Chosen model + drive/res settings for the role

constraints: Ground every step in the source YouTube-provided Show-transcript text; do not invent UI paths or numeric settings not stated there.

Original synthesis / signal-flow only — map brand UI (Serum/Vital/Ableton/etc.) to portable osc/filter/env/LFO/FX modules for Traveler-inspired or Web Audio hybrid; never rip presets, wavetables, or samples.
Prefer transferable parameter relationships over vendor-specific preset or bank names.
Map Vital-named models to portable descriptions (transistor ladder, diode ladder, formant, comb, phaser); ignore proprietary custom spectral editor unless recreating conceptually.

steps.action: Start with standard modes: low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, notch, peak. Note 12 vs 24 dB slopes; many multimode filters morph LP↔BP↔HP (or LP/HP via notch) with blend.

A/B design flavors at same cutoff with LFO on cutoff: raise drive then resonance. Ladder/analog tend similar (ladder often more resonant); ‘dirty’ grit scales strongly with drive; digital may sound harsher or sometimes smoother/controlled.
Try diode model (historically EMS workaround vs Moog transistor ladder; famous in TB-303 acid). Expect different resonance scaling—re-adjust resonance when switching from ladder.
Formant filters: use XY-style controls for vowels (A/O/I/E or A/I/U/O sets); peak strength, spread between peaks, and formant transpose (pitch of the formant structure).

Comb: duplicate + tiny delay + remix → peak/null series. Enable key tracking aligned to pitch to shape harmonics; type semitone offsets carefully to avoid inharmonic chaos unless desired. Resonance can go ±; useful for phasing/flanging-like motion and physical-ish string tones.

Self-oscillation: with enough drive+resonance, ladder/analog/dirty/diode (and comb when tuned) can keep sounding after the osc dies if the note is held; digital/formant typically do not. Use for singing filter tones or comb pluck realism.
Phaser-like filters resemble sparse combs; set pole/notch count via blend, reshape with resonance, add cutoff modulation for classic sweep. Pick model by ear for bass/lead/pad roles.

verification: Can name when to reach for ladder vs diode vs formant vs comb
Comb key-tracked offset stays musical when desired
